meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从日志、会话数据和挂载配置里排查容器代理启动或认证失败的根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果容器代理跑不起来或登录异常,想快速定位原因
copy.tagline_en: Trace container agent failures to root cause through logs, session data, and mount config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent won't run or fails to authenticate and you need the cause fast

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你排查容器化 agent 的运行问题:读主机与容器日志、查会话数据库、检查挂载，定位消息没回复、容器闪退、认证失败等原因。
howto.when: 当消息没有回复、容器启动后立刻退出、出现认证问题，或你想弄懂这套容器系统如何运作时会用到。

say.text: 容器起不来，帮我看看日志和退出码
机器人不回复了，帮我查消息有没有到容器
日志级别开到 debug，把挂载和启动命令打出来
say.note: 给出设 LOG_LEVEL=debug 的方法

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps you debug the containerized agent system: reading host and container logs, querying session DBs, checking mounts, and tracing why replies fail, containers exit, or auth breaks.
howto.when_en: Use it when messages get no reply, a container exits immediately, authentication fails, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The container won't start, check the logs and exit code
say_en.note: Looks at the spawn/exit lines in logs/nanoclaw.log

say_en.text: The bot stopped replying, check if messages reached the container
Turn on debug logging and print the mounts and spawn command
